thread:
Alice Chen: Heads-up — uploaded sentinel-30b raw checkpoint to s3://redwood-models/staging/sentinel-30b/raw/ (parts-000[0-7].pt). Need safetensors conversion + tp4 shard layout. Who can take the conversion run today?

Ben Ortiz: I can take it after standup. Quick checklist: convert -> verify checksums -> generate shardmap.json -> run smoke serve.

Carmen Li: @Ben please also check tokenizer metadata. Last time some tokenizers lacked <bos> which breaks prompt framing.

Ben Ortiz: noted. Which tokenizer format is this one? HF tokenizer.json + merges.

Alice Chen: HF format. Tokenizer file in s3: s3://redwood-models/staging/sentinel-30b/tokenizer/tokenizer.json. I spotted special_tokens_map missing "bos_token" and "eos_token" entries.

Raj Patel: For packaging, prefer output dtype bf16 by default for this model (backed perf tests). But load-time conversion can use fp16 if hardware doesn't support bf16. Add `dtype` flag in manifest.

Ben Ortiz: Plan: 1) run safetensors conversion with tp=4 2) shard into 4 worker shards named sentinel-30b-tp4-000..003.safetensors 3) produce shardmap and manifest. Command I'm going to run:

```bash
# run conversion (local container)
python tools/convert_to_safetensors.py \
  --input s3://redwood-models/staging/sentinel-30b/raw/ \
  --output /tmp/sentinel-30b-safetensors/ \
  --tensor-parallel 4 --dtype bf16
```

Ben Ortiz: After that I'll upload to s3://redwood-models/staging/sentinel-30b/packaged/v1/ and ping here.

Carmen Li: Two quick tokenizer notes: 1) add special_tokens_map: {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"} 2) tokenizer.json uses lowercase tokens; verify encoding for multi-byte chars. I can run tokenization sanity on the test prompts.

Alice Chen: Awesome. Also add model card metadata `max_sequence_length` and `kv_cache_layout` (we use legacy kv chunking for TP). Manifest should include: {"path": "s3://.../sentinel-30b-tp4-000.safetensors", "dtype": "bf16", "tp_size": "4", "layout": "tp_interleaved_kv_legacy"}

Raj Patel: One more: add a `quant_profile` entry in manifest: "none" for now. We'll run quant suggestion in optimize later.

packaging-bot: checksum OK for parts-0000.pt -> s3 upload verified (sha256: a4f3...c9e2).

Ben Ortiz: Conversion started, ETA ~20m. I'll post the shardmap & manifest once uploaded.

Carmen Li: I'll run tokenizer sanity and a small generate (prompt: "Translate to French: Hello world") after upload. If BOS missing, you may need to prepend manually in the tokenizer wrapper.

Alice Chen: Thx. If smoke serve fails, fall back to fp16 and notify infra for node allocation.

Ben Ortiz: Uploaded packaged shards and manifest: s3://redwood-models/staging/sentinel-30b/packaged/v1/
Shard files: sentinel-30b-tp4-000.safetensors .. -003.safetensors
manifest.json uploaded.

packaging-bot: manifest.json validated (fields present: path,dtype,tp_size,layout,quant_profile,checksum).

Carmen Li: Tokenizer sanity: OK for basic prompts but multi-byte test failing (emoji handling). Patching tokenizer to normalize unicode before encode. Pushing tiny patch to repo, PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412 (small tokenizer-normalize).

Ben Ortiz: Smoke serve results: served on staging route /models/sentinel-30b/v1 (tp4). Latency 95th=310ms on short prompt, tokens produced correctly after patch. No crashes.

Alice Chen: Great — marking onboarding checklist item DONE and assigning to QA for broader perf sweep. Thanks team! :tada:
